full_judgment: 7. Mr. Moin Uddin, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners has placed the annexures-A to K (1) Order of Trial Court and also placed the impugned order dated 24.10.2007 passed by the District Judge, Dhaka and submitted that the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal and that the learned District Judge has passed order beyond scope of the subject matter of the civil revision case No. 170 of 2007 in as much as the defendant preferred Civil Revision before the learned District Judge against the order dated 13.2.2007 passed by the Assistant Judge but the learned District Judge while disposing the revisional application has considered certain orders which were not impugned before the revisional Court and arrived at erroneous findings and allowed the amendment of the written statement though such question was resolved and closed by judgment and order dated 4.4.2005 in the civil Revision No. 2127 of 2004 and committed fundamental error of law and thereby an important question of law has arisen which calls for interference by this Hon'ble Court. Mr. Moinuddin further submits that the impugned order suffers from gross illegality as the learned District Judge has acted in access of his jurisdiction and those being the important question of law has caused failure of justice.
